summary: Melee hybrid built around Stormstrike windows, weapon-imbue uptime and Flurry/Maelstrom Weapon procs. Forever's biggest change for the spec: Enhancement is built around a single Two-Handed weapon instead of Classic's dual-wield, reshaping weapon imbue and stat choices.

mechanicalChanges.detail: Enhancement no longer dual-wields in Forever; the spec is balanced around one 2H weapon. This changes weapon imbue choice (one slot instead of two) and melee stat scaling vs. Classic Era.
A Shaman-only quest at level 30 rewards a powerful early 2H weapon (fist weapon or 2H mace options reported).

statPriority.notes: Strength scales attack power directly; Agility adds crit/dodge/AP. Hit and Crit matter but don't out-prioritize primary melee stats at low level.

level30: Stormstrike on cooldown (8 sec) — build the whole rotation around this timer
Earth Shock as the instant filler right after Stormstrike
Flame Shock / Fire Nova for AoE and sustained damage on totem pulls
Lightning Bolt as mana-efficient ranged filler when melee isn't possible
Keep weapon imbue (Windfury/Rockbiter/Flametongue) active at all times

recommendedBuild.pointsAtLevel30Example: 5/5 Thundering Strikes, 1/5 Ancestral Knowledge, 3/3 Mental Dexterity, 2/2 Improved Ghost Wolf, 3/3 Elemental Weapons, 1/1 Shamanistic Focus, 4/5 Flurry, 1/1 Stormstrike, 1/2 Improved Stormstrike
recommendedBuild.note: Builds observed across community sources skew heavily into the Enhancement tree (commonly 11/33/0-shaped at level 60) to pick up Stormstrike, Flurry, Maelstrom Weapon and Rage of the Farseer.

caveat: Forever is in beta; numbers and talent effects can change with hotfixes. Cross-check against data/shaman.json (talentsforever.com export) before publishing hard numbers.
